purpose: Predeclared service-first evaluation on later source periods; no outcome-based selection
geant_source_rule: Require all native DEMANDS sections in each replay day and its lookback to be nonempty; missing sections are unknown and never imputed. Do not replace days on seeing outcomes.
transforms: Original training-only pair selection, traffic scaling, normalization and assumed capacities; fixed for all methods
carbon: GEANT daily 2022 seasonal pairing; Abilene EPA 2004 annual rates
interpretation: One training seed; adjacent days; trace-driven simulated workload, assumed capacities and carbon proxy; replay is not packet-level or measured emissions
